query:
SELECT
                    s.id
                FROM
                    email_sync_streams s
                WHERE
                    s.provider = 'IMAP'
                    AND s.kind IN ('folder_catalog', 'mail_folder')
                    AND s.id > $1
                    AND NOT EXISTS (
                        SELECT
                            1
                        FROM
                            email_imap_host_catchup_deferred d
                        WHERE
                            d.stream_id = s.id
                    )
                ORDER BY
                    s.id
                LIMIT
                    $2
